title: Front-End Developer
description: We are looking for a Front-End Developer to build and maintain user-facing features for our web applications. You will work closely with designers and back-end engineers to ship responsive, accessible interfaces.

title: Front-End Engineer
description: As a Front-End Engineer, you'll turn Figma designs into pixel-perfect, responsive interfaces using modern JavaScript frameworks and component-driven development practices.

title: Backend Engineer
description: Design and maintain REST APIs and database schemas that power our core product. You'll work primarily in Node.js and PostgreSQL with a focus on reliability and clean data modeling.

title: Full Stack Developer
description: Join our small team building a SaaS product end to end, from React front end to Node.js back end, with MongoDB for storage and Docker for local development.

title: Data Analyst
description: Analyze business data to produce actionable insights. You'll write SQL queries, build dashboards, and present findings to stakeholders using data visualization tools.

title: UX/UI Designer
description: Own the end-to-end design process for our mobile and web products, from user research and wireframing to high-fidelity prototypes in Figma.

title: DevOps Engineer
description: Maintain and improve our CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure. Strong background in containerization and AWS is essential.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Build and deploy machine learning models for production use cases. Experience with PyTorch and data preprocessing pipelines is required.

title: QA Engineer
description: Ensure product quality through manual and automated testing. You'll write test plans, track bugs, and build out our Selenium test suite alongside the engineering team using Git for version control.

title: Customer Support Representative
description: Provide friendly, timely support to customers via chat and email. Strong communication skills and patience are a must.
